question: ESS is a Computer based system that allows users to transform enterprise data. ESS stands for:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Executive Senior System.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Executive Support System** (ESS) belongs to software which allows users to interchange enterprise data into fast accessible and executive-level reports, such as those used by billing, accounting and staffing departments. 
 
• The ESS improves decision-making for executives.
 
• ESS is also called Executive Information System (EIS).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Advantages of ESS(Executive support system):__**

 __
 
• **​__**Easy for upper level executive to use.
 
• Ability to analyze trends.
 
• Augmentation of managers' leadership capabilities.
 
• Enhance personal thinking and decision-making.
 
• Contribution to strategic control flexibility.
 
• Enhance organizational competitiveness in the market place.
 
• Instruments of change.
